name: 984-longdecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), fp16, 4096-token context, ~13.5 GB of weights in two ungated safetensors shards.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain (the checkpoint is a base model and ships no chat template), 128 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens fixed (min = max = mean on both), greedy temperature 0.0, ignore_eos true, empty stop list.
purpose: A long-form story continuation service on one 7B model, 64 concurrent streams, short prompts, 512-token replies, single GPU.
launch:
# September 2023 vLLM: `EngineArgs` accepts 18 fields plus the three `AsyncEngineArgs` adds, and
# an unknown key is a TypeError at construction. Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- no
# prefix caching, no CUDA graphs, no `enforce_eager`, no `max_seq_len_to_capture`, no V1 engine.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Spelled `half` and not `float16`: this era's `--dtype` accepts only
# {auto, half, bfloat16, float}. It is what `auto` resolves to for this checkpoint.
dtype: half

max-model-len: 4096

# The rest are this engine's own defaults, written out so a later vLLM's changed derivation
# cannot move them. In September 2023 `max-num-batched-tokens` is a literal 2560 and not a value
# derived from `max_model_len`.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2560
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
